method.positionSpace: Decoded POSITION slots transformed by each primitive's matrixWorld; source-export units m
method.weld: Per structure across all primitives: each finite world component maps to Math.round(component / gridMeters); identical integer triples share a vertex. This is grid quantization, not a Euclidean distance weld. Adjacent cells do not merge; negative half values follow JavaScript Math.round.
method.edgeIncidence: Undirected welded vertex pairs counted once per incident triangle; boundary=1, nonmanifold>2. Triangles with repeated welded vertices are reported and excluded; collinear distinct vertices are not removed. Invalid-position triangles are reported and excluded, but any nonfinite position fails the audit.
method.vertexSlots: Sum of decoded position attribute counts, including duplicate seam slots and unused slots; not a count of unique anatomical points
method.worldBounds: Axis-aligned min/max from finite transformed slots, before welding; engineering extents in m, not tissue measurements

limitations: These are engineering counts and source-mesh metadata, not medical accuracy scores or clinical validation.
An open boundary can be intentional in a schematic membrane/surface; it is not automatically an asset error.
Polygon count, closed topology and authored thickness do not establish anatomical accuracy, measured tissue thickness or verified volume.
The ten curated pilots retain their source schematic open surfaces; no production geometry was replaced. Other structures are not classified by polygon thresholds.
